tasks.connect:check: deno task --cwd packages/connect-solid check && deno task --cwd packages/protocol check && deno task --cwd packages/client check
tasks.connect:test: deno task --cwd packages/connect-solid test && deno task --cwd packages/client test
tasks.site:publish: deno run -A npm:wrangler@4.119.0 pages deploy site/dist --project-name rustyauth-dev --branch main --commit-dirty=true
tasks.fmt: cargo fmt && deno fmt deno.json buf.yaml buf.gen.yaml packages/client packages/connect-solid packages/protocol/deno.json packages/protocol/index.ts site/src site/tests site/astro.config.mjs site/deno.json site/package.json dashboard
tasks.fmt:check: cargo fmt --check && deno fmt --check deno.json buf.yaml buf.gen.yaml packages/client packages/connect-solid packages/protocol/deno.json packages/protocol/index.ts site/src site/tests site/astro.config.mjs site/deno.json site/package.json dashboard && cd infra/cloudflare && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"
tasks.lint: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && deno lint packages/client/src packages/connect-solid/src packages/protocol/index.ts site/src site/tests site/astro.config.mjs dashboard/src dashboard/vite.config.ts && cd infra/cloudflare && go vet ./...
tasks.check: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task connect:check && deno task site:check && deno task dashboard:check
tasks.test: deno task connect:test && deno task site:test && deno task dashboard:build && cargo test --locked && cd infra/cloudflare && go test ./...
